summary: Tillamook County, OR aluminum-type 14x14 Amort cab built by ODF in 1950, staffed in 1957, removed in 1963; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 14x14 Amort aluminum-type cab set directly on the ground
facts.status_note: Removed in 1963 per the FFLOS register and the Forest Lookouts page; firelookout.com marks it gone

events.note: 14x14 Amort Special lookout house; total cost $2281.60 per the 1950 annual report to ODF
October 1951: lookout came through the last Tillamook fire in good shape; house not damaged
June 1957: Ruby Wells transferred to the Grindstone lookout for the rest of the summer (Vernonia Eagle)
Registered November 7, 2019 as US 1799, OR 523; nominated by Tammy McLeod

notes_for_editor: Register, Forest Lookouts page and firelookout.com agree on the 1950 build and the 1963 removal. The 1957 staffing rests on one newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. Nothing found on what remains at the site today. Record coordinates (45.350811, -123.66312) match the FFLOS register; firelookout.org list gives 45.35121, -123.66293, about 40 m apart; left unchanged. No photos added; the register's 1950-1963 photo credit has no license checked.
